complete_same_domain_rewind_indistinguis.world_A: The repository legitimately never advanced beyond S = GRANTED(g1).
complete_same_domain_rewind_indistinguis.world_B: The repository advanced to CANCELLED(g1), compacted witnesses, then every allowed repository witness was completely rewound/restored to byte-identical S = GRANTED(g1).
complete_same_domain_rewind_indistinguis.current_allowed_observation: identical byte state S in both worlds
complete_same_domain_rewind_indistinguis.consequence: Any deterministic stateless decision using only allowed current same-domain state is identical. Admit preserves liveness in A but re-admits stale authority in B; reject preserves B safety but false-blocks A. A non-rewound monotonic assumption/witness is necessary to distinguish the pair.

mechanism_conclusion.preferred_scoped_compaction: Under the explicit no-complete-authority-rewind assumption, a monotonic generation watermark per incarnation-sensitive canonical task/effect key is the smallest tested compact witness: every old reservation generation at or below the watermark remains retired after its bulky tombstone is removed, including stale-cell restore, provided every authority path consults that watermark and stable cell incarnation identity is preserved.
mechanism_conclusion.per_cell_floor_alternative: A monotonic retired-holder floor on every stable logical cell is also safe, but a spanning reservation cannot drop its tombstone until the full required cell set has durable floors. Partial floor propagation therefore retains the tombstone longer.
mechanism_conclusion.naive_cleanup_gc: Deleting a reservation tombstone merely because cells are currently clean is unsafe if a stale holder row can later be restored.
mechanism_conclusion.key_incarnation: Watermarks and terminal indexes must be scoped to a task/effect key incarnation; logical-key reuse without incarnation causes false rejection of the new history.
mechanism_conclusion.complete_rewind: No witness stored entirely in the completely rewound repository state can distinguish never-cancelled from cancelled-then-rewound when the resulting bytes are identical.

phase1_assessment.repository_local_generation_watermark: Chat-capable and zero incremental cost in the tested no-complete-rewind scope; uses lightweight repository state/CAS only and no hosted compute, paid/trial/monthly credit, external coordinator, or manual user execution.
phase1_assessment.branch_protection_as_anti_rollback: Not accepted as a generic Phase-1 solution: it is protected/admin repository configuration, and GitHub documents plan-dependent availability for private repositories. It may be a deployment assumption in some environments but cannot satisfy the fixed zero-protected-step/zero-paid-dependency requirement generically.
phase1_assessment.residual_richer_mode_or_manual_user_exec: none for scoped repository-local watermark compaction

scope_limit: One cancelled reservation at a time over one to three stable logical cells; compaction witnesses are abstract monotonic fields. Full rewind is an explicit indistinguishability pair rather than a probabilistic failure model.
exact_continuation: Anti-rollback redesign without protected/admin settings or paid/quota-bearing infrastructure. Audit whether any scheduled-Chat-visible, zero-cost, non-rewound state exists outside the repository authority bytes (for example immutable connector response identity, current Git object ancestry reachable without a remembered SHA, or automation-native durable state) while respecting CLEAN semantic-input rules. Falsify each candidate against a complete branch rewind where all repository current bytes and own role-local files revert. If no admissible surviving state exists, formalize the complete-rewind case as an unresolved capability boundary and move to the next non-conflicting concurrency leaf: crash-safe effect-status reconciliation for repository-local AUTHORIZED transitions.
